senses.gloss:
Pika, the Indian ‘cuckoo,’ is mentioned in the list of victims at the aśvamedha (‘horse sacrifice’) in the yajurveda Saṃhitās. Cf. anyavāpa, koka.
Foot notes taittirīya Saṃhitā, v. 5, 15, 1; Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 14, 20; Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 39. Cf. Zimmer, Altindisches Leben, 92.
